LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do tense, time and aspect enhance communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify main verbs and primary auxiliary verbs

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. identify main verbs and primary auxiliary verbs

   Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. pick out verbs to be, verbs to have and verbs to do from a given text.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. pick out verbs to be, verbs to have and verbs to do from a given text.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn as learner seeks advice and support from each other as they search for regular and irregular verbs

from print or digital texts.

● Critical Thinking/Active listening as the learner actively listens to an audio text and identifies gradable and non- gradable adverbs and adverbs of place and time.

Values:
● Love is promoted as the learner’s generosity is enhanced as they share ideas with others on adverbs.

33

● Responsibility is enhanced as the learner engages in the assigned role as they search for regular and irregular verbs

from print or digital texts.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Socio-economic issues - environmental education and climate change: The learners enhance their knowledge as they listen

to a theme-based audio text or read one and identify gradable and non-gradable adverbs and adverbs of place and time.

Suggested Learning Resources: Dictionaries, chart, digital devices, audio visuals, Internet, adapted digital devices with

filter keys/key guards/larger mouse/head control input devices such as head wand. universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces,

weighted pencil/pen grips
